label: V6.4.131 - FULL PERFORMANCE
notes: Full performance batch: retain canonical receive fast path; compact forms registry by about 38 percent; lazy-load form background images; coalesce duplicate registry network/layout work; scope Form Registry UI observers; move PDF prewarm off the critical render path; reduce non-critical legacy UI polling; and coalesce registry requests in the service worker while preserving strict no-store update checks. UI and business workflow remain unchanged.
message: V6.4.131: tối ưu toàn bộ tốc độ/trải nghiệm mobile và startup, giữ nguyên giao diện/nghiệp vụ và cơ chế cập nhật bắt buộc.
